LanguageData.BOR_Sunweave_Chemical_Addiction.descript: A chemical addiction to Sunweavium . Long-term presence of Sunweave-based Chemicals has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. Without regular doses of Sunweave-based Chemicals from drugs like flake or yayo, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
